title: Case: Parcel addressed to a pickup point is travelling back to the merchant after one attempt
context: A recipient chose delivery to a pickup point instead of her home. After one recorded attempt the parcel was put into the return stream to Rookhaven Goods.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Delivery investigations to review the 10 Mar 11:52 'pickup point closed' scan against the pickup point's statement that it was open and no driver came, and to give a written finding.

must: Sends the conflict to Delivery investigations, Larkspire Arc Logistics, for DL-7525.

Sets out both accounts without choosing between them: the driver's 10 Mar 11:52 'pickup point closed' scan, and the pickup point's statement that it was open 07:00 to 19:00, no driver came in and nothing was refused.
Asks for a written finding on the failed attempt, and says Rookhaven Goods' Warehouse dispatch are waiting on it to settle who bears the second carriage.
must_not: Promises, requests or implies a second delivery attempt at the pickup point, or says the parcel will go to Sedgemoor Lane News today, when it is already on the return trunk and cannot be intercepted.
States as fact that the driver never attended or made a false scan, or that the shop was closed.
Tells the recipient she will not be charged for a second carriage, or that the parcel will be re-sent or refunded.
Treats the tracking scan as settling the matter and tells the recipient the attempt was valid.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please open a review of the failed attempt on DL-7525 (Rookhaven Goods order TG-3554), addressed to pickup point Sedgemoor Lane News. Your driver's scan on 10 Mar at 11:52 reads 'pickup point closed, could not deliver'. The pickup point's staff tell us they were open 07:00 to 19:00 that day, that no Larkspire Arc driver came in, that nothing was refused and that they had shelf space; they offer their till roll for 11:30 to 12:30. I am not assuming either account is right. The parcel was set to return to sender at 14:05 the same day and is on the return trunk, due at Rookhaven's warehouse on 12 Mar; Dispatch and the Recovery team say it cannot be intercepted. Please review the stop record and give a written finding on the attempt. Rookhaven's Warehouse dispatch need it to decide who bears the second carriage, and the recipient is disputing that cost. Please tell me when the finding will be ready.
